displayName: Best Buy Product Data API - Open-Box Prices, Store Stock, Deals, Reviews
description: Best Buy product data as structured JSON - search bestbuy.com or browse any category or deals page, 18 products per page, with price, regular price, savings, deal badge, condition, rating and seller type, filtered by brand, on sale, clearance, open box or a price range, read one product by SKU with UPC, model, every open-box offer by condition (fair, good, excellent) with its price and savings, the full spec table and the AI review summary, check store pickup status of a SKU at up to 8 stores near a ZIP, find stores with 35 days of dated hours, get today's Deal of the Day, batch prices for up to 15 SKUs, page first-party reviews with the star histogram and pros and cons, and pull search autocomplete. 9 endpoints, 2 credits each; stores and suggestions 1, deals and pcmcat category pages 3.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
